<article id="post-11844" class="post-11844 page type-page status-publish" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" itemscope>
	<div class="inside-article">
		
		<div class="entry-content" itemprop="text">
					<div data-elementor-type="wp-page" data-elementor-id="11844" class="elementor elementor-11844 elementor-10236" data-elementor-post-type="page">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4f1e570 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="4f1e570" data-element_type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a82c78e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="a82c78e" data-element_type="container">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8718986 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="8718986" data-element_type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c6b529d e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="c6b529d" data-element_type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-840cc87 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="840cc87" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h1>Kitesurfing – experience one of Denmark’s most wind-reliable kite spots</h1><h2>Ideal conditions for both beginners and experienced kitesurfers</h2><p>Looking for a kite spot in Jutland with perfect conditions for kitesurfing? At <a href="/en/" target="_self">Thorsminde Camping</a> by Nissum Fjord, you’ll find one of the best spots in Denmark for both beginners and experienced riders. Located close to towns like Thyborøn, Holstebro and Ringkøbing, and between the North Sea and Nissum Fjord, you get access to one of Europe’s most wind-reliable areas, where you can kitesurf in safe, shallow waters with no rocks and plenty of space. For many guests, the combination of nature, wind conditions and professional instructors is a key reason for choosing Thorsminde as their regular surf spot.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-0825cf0 light e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="0825cf0" data-element_type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-cb06074 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="cb06074" data-element_type="container">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-acd6e54 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="acd6e54" data-element_type="container">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a341287 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="a341287" data-element_type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4d0da5e e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="4d0da5e" data-element_type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9e1234a elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="9e1234a" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<div class="pointer-events-none -mt-px h-px translate-y-[calc(var(--scroll-root-safe-area-inset-bottom)-14*var(--spacing))]" aria-hidden="true"><span style="font-size: inherit;">Nissum Fjord is a protected bird reserve and may therefore only be used for water sports during the period 1/4–31/10. There may also be designated zones with restrictions, as shown on the map at the campsite. </span></div>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4a74333 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="4a74333" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h2>A kite spot with optimal conditions</h2><p>Nissum Fjord is known for its unique kitesurfing conditions. The shallow area with no rocks makes the fjord ideal for both learning and training, and you can get started quickly – whether you’re new to the sport or want to improve your skills. Here, you get access to a kite spot where safety, comfort and great conditions go hand in hand. As our guest, you can, among other things, use:​   </p><ul><li>Shallow training areas</li><li>Great wind conditions all year round</li><li>Kitesurfing right by the fjord</li><li>Access to the campsite facilities</li><li>Option to buy a day pass if you’re not staying on site​</li></ul><p>A day pass costs DKK 75 per day and can be purchased by contacting reception. Alternatively, you can reach us by phone. That way, we ensure that all kitesurfers – both locals and tourists – can enjoy our unique surroundings.  </p><h2>What is kitesurfing?</h2><p>Kitesurfing is a water sport where you stand on a board and are pulled along by a large controllable kite. The sport combines elements of surfing, sailing and wakeboarding, and it lets you enjoy speed, manoeuvres and jumps – depending on your level and the wind conditions. In Denmark, kitesurfing is especially popular on the west coast, where the wind often provides optimal conditions.  </p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9484d1a e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="9484d1a" data-element_type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-f8a1fbb e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="f8a1fbb" data-element_type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d208437 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="d208437" data-element_type="container">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-5451a70 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="5451a70" data-element_type="container" data-settings="{&quot;background_background&quot;:&quot;classic&quot;}">
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-70e8875 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="70e8875" data-element_type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4aeece6 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="4aeece6" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h2>Take a kitesurfing course with professional instructors</h2><p>Dreaming of learning kitesurfing from scratch? With us, you can take a kitesurfing course run according to VDWS guidelines. We offer a beginner course in Jutland, where you train with experienced instructors who guide you through techniques, equipment and safety. The course runs over seven days, and all necessary equipment is provided.​   </p><h3 class="">The equipment includes:</h3><ul><li>Wetsuit</li><li>Kite</li><li>Board</li><li>Safety equipment​</li></ul><p>This makes it easy to get started, even if you don’t already have your own gear. Many choose Thorsminde as their first kite spot because the shallow fjord environment makes learning safer and more manageable. See the website for the German school <strong><a href="https://www.kite-school-tours.de/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">here</a></strong>.​  </p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d7c0b05 dark e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="d7c0b05" data-element_type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-dda2d87 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="dda2d87" data-element_type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1511898 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="1511898" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h2>Kitesurfing on the North Sea – an experience for life</h2><p>At Thorsminde Camping, you get access to a kite spot that combines nature, technique and great conditions. You can kitesurf right by the fjord, take a break at the campsite and continue when the wind is optimal again. It’s a flexible kind of holiday where you can combine kitesurfing with a stay in a <a href="/en/cabins/">camping cabin</a>, tent, motorhome or caravan. Whether you’re after action, training or simply an introduction to the sport, our location and facilities give you a strong starting point for a holiday full of speed and freedom.</p><h2>How much does kitesurfing cost?</h2><p data-start="0" data-end="174">The price of kitesurfing depends on whether you’re staying on site. If you stay overnight at Thorsminde Camping, access to the fjord is included, while day visitors can buy access for DKK 75.</p><p data-start="176" data-end="283" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">If you have questions about kitesurfing or would like to book a course, you can contact Tobias on 0049 179 510 2925.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>
		<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c4e7ef8 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="c4e7ef8" data-element_type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-eabf312 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="eabf312" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h2>Contact us to learn more about kitesurfing</h2><p>Want to know more about our kitesurfing courses or learn how you can become a kitesurfer in just seven days? Contact Tobias on <a href="tel:0049%20179%20510%202925">0049 179 510 2925</a> for more information, and we’ll get back to you as quickly as possible. We look forward to welcoming you to Thorsminde Camping – one of the most attractive kitesurfing spots in Denmark.  </p>								</div>

					</div>
				</div>

		</main>
